vintage (classic, or old enough to be recognizably outdated but not old enough to be antique)

examples.english: Once you have your hands on all the vintage clothes you bought, one of the first things you should do is wash it, since it could have stayed in the store for a long time without being washed beforehand.
examples.ref: 2019 August 9, Paola Jiménez, “Tips que te ayudarán a la hora de comprar ropa vintage [Tips that will help you when you're buying vintage clothes]”, in El Universal:
examples.text: Cuando tengas en tus manos toda la ropa vintage que compraste, una de las primeras cosas que debes hacer es lavarla, ya que pudo haber permanecido en la tienda por mucho tiempo sin haber sido lavada antes.
examples.translation: Once you have your hands on all the vintage clothes you bought, one of the first things you should do is wash it, since it could have stayed in the store for a long time without being washed beforehand.

examples.english: The new collection combines the classicism of some garments, especially the footwear, with a vintage eighties style.
examples.ref: 2020 January 14, “Gucci cierra Semana de la Moda en Milán rompiendo estereotipos masculinos [Gucci closes Milan Fashion Week by breaking masculine stereotypes]”, in El Nacional (Venezuela):
examples.text: La nueva colección combina el clasicismo de algunas prendas, especialmente en el calzado, con un estilo vintage de los ochenta.
examples.translation: The new collection combines the classicism of some garments, especially the footwear, with a vintage eighties style.

examples.english: Models and styles very a lot, but there's one that never goes out of fashion: vintage or retro.
examples.ref: 2022 July 22, Beatriz Gámez Jareño, “Las neveras de estilo vintage más encantadoras para tu cocina [The most charming vintage style refrigerators for your kitchen]”, in El País:
examples.text: Los modelos y estilos son muy variados, pero hay uno que nunca pasa de moda: el estilo vintage o retro.
examples.translation: Models and styles very a lot, but there's one that never goes out of fashion: vintage or retro.

glosses: vintage (classic, or old enough to be recognizably outdated but not old enough to be antique)
